tools.name: get_risk_check_questions
tools.description: Use when a U.S. lawyer or law firm wants to check how safely their firm uses generative AI. Returns the 12 questions, each with options a, b and c. Ask the user every question, then call score_ai_practice_risk with their answers.

tools.name: score_ai_practice_risk
tools.description: Scores the 12 AI Practice Risk Check answers from get_risk_check_questions. Returns a score out of 100 (higher is better), results in seven areas (ethics, confidentiality, verification, supervision, vendor risk, cybersecurity, competitive readiness), the three weakest areas with one next step each,

tools.name: explain_ai_ethics_duties
tools.description: Use when a U.S. lawyer asks what ethics duties apply to using generative AI. Gives a short, general summary of the duties covered by ABA Formal Opinion 512 (July 29, 2024): competence, confidentiality, communication, candor, supervision and fees. States adopt their own rules and guidance, so always
